fact.summary: A PR review keeps one result per format (PrReview.results.v1 / v2 + shown); posted stays on the review; a one-time store migration moves old top-level fields to v2 (with a report) or v1. Each format runs in its own mag topic (session.reviewFormat); set_pr_review records into the calling topic's format and enforces its form (v1 verdict+findings, v2 report); decide_direction and discuss work on results.v2. Run v1 / Run v2, the v1|v2 switch (shown + ownerSessionId), a format picker at start and a project default (Project.reviewFormat, v2). The v1 prompt is restored as playbook section prReviewV1; prReviewPrompt picks the text per format; one inventory per head: any run at a head that has one reads it instead of writing it anew. Lists, ready text, state, poll and publish read the shown result; review_pr tells a topic to run one format only.
